name: Acadian Wood Products
old_description: Our mission is to partner with our vendors and customers to provide unparalleled products, service and solutions to the specialty hardwoods market.
about:
Acadian Wood Products, operating as AWP Wood Products, is based in Little Rock, Arkansas. The company’s founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It presents itself as a partner to vendors and customers in the specialty hardwoods market, emphasizing old-school service and top-quality merchandise.

The firm distributes a range of products including hardwoods, hinges, slides, adhesives, building supplies, and treated lumber. It also offers custom millwork services, with quoted lead times of two hours for standard orders and four hours for custom milling. The business operates Monday through Friday, 7:30 am to 5 pm. No details on facility size, headcount, or annual volume are provided.

The company targets the specialty hardwoods market, serving customers who need hardwoods and related building supplies. Concrete customer types or industry segments beyond “specialty hardwoods” are not specified in the available information.

AWP Wood Products states that it sources exactly what customers need, negotiates pricing with suppliers, and passes savings along. Its stated mission is to provide unparalleled products, service, and solutions through vendor and customer partnerships.
